The new waveform column, status enum changes, and VideoCompose job type need to be reflected in regression tests, but story 06 only mentions updating tests/regression/test_stack.py without specifying which new entities/models must be covered. The check could pass if the regression suite doesn't test the new AudioSegment waveform column at all."]}}, 'summary': "The plan covers the epic's scope well and the story sequencing is logical, but fails on four of five dimensions. Key issues: (1) Journey completeness fails because waveform rendering and post-retry status visibility lack DOM-level verification. (2) Transition coverage fails because critical UI transitions (Process button renders, Comparison tab renders, video player renders, retry success) lack corresponding checkpoints. (3) Gap detection fails on several architectural gaps: no WebSocket token issuance mechanism, potential child job user_id nullability, Redis channel naming alignment between worker and webapp, nginx routing for nested /jobs/{id}, and the scheduler BC fix leaves T3K token refresh with no replacement. (4) Validation sufficiency fails because several checkpoints are shallow (grep excludes migrations, WS check uses HTTP evidence fields, comparison endpoint check doesn't verify waveform data, VIDEO_COMPOSE acceptance doesn't verify execution). The plan needs gap-filling stories or expanded checkpoints before execution."}
